subject: Marine Works - Fraser River
text:
Marine Works - Fraser River
Marine Support for the salvage of the vessel Fraser Titan in the vicinity of 49 13.048N 122 50.288W.
Hours of operation daily from 1400UTC to 0000UTC Oct 15 to Dec 19. 
Vessels on site monitoring VHF Ch. 69.
Mariners are advised to use caution around transiting barges.
